methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: By means of a questionnaire, this study aims to analyze energy management practices in energy intensive Turkish industries.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Questionnaire-based survey of corporate energy-management practices that categorises firms via a qualitative minimum-requirement checklist / analytical framework; no EnPI or EnB measurement model is presented or characterised (sector energy-intensity figures are cited incidentally from external sources).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The survey was carried out as a multiple case study of the Turkish iron, steel, cement, paper, ceramics and textile industries.

stage1.notes: Rayyan 'Maybe'. In-scope sectors (steel/cement/paper) present, but paper assesses EM practices via a qualitative checklist, not an EnPI/EnB model; ineligible under v2.3. Worth human check.
